_doc: GIN training seed·대표 outer unit 사전 확정. docs/64 §5 확정값. ladder_freeze.json 무수정(별도 동결).

representative_unit_rule.text: For each split seed s in {201,202,203}, take the SHA-256 digest of the newline-free ASCII decimal string of s, interpret the full digest as an unsigned 256-bit integer, and use that integer modulo 5 as the zero-based fold index.
representative_unit_rule.researcher_dof_disclosure: Rule adopted 2026-08-05 after inspecting fold composition tables but before any GIN training, prediction, or performance result. Only this one hash rule was computed; no alternative hash/encoding/modulus variants were evaluated.

seed_namespace_note: train_seed=42 is the GIN training RNG id. It is a different parameter from split_seed=42 (development split, excluded from confirmatory analysis) and from RandomForest random_state=42.
model_scope_rationale: docs/30 §13 budget clause scopes the GIN allocation with '동일 세트'; running all seven avoids a narrowing amendment. Primary reported decomposition = Δ(M2b − M1b); remaining models reported as supplementary.
delta_definition: Delta_ij = macroAP_ij(M2b) - macroAP_ij(M1b), computed on the held-out fold of outer unit i under training seed j.
delta_unit_caveat: This fold-level evaluation unit differs from the confirmatory estimand, which is the complete-OOF metric over all 1,092 drugs.
macro_ap_rule: Frozen preregistration §7 rule, unchanged: eligible PT set = 370 (global positives >= 10); within a cell, PTs with zero in-sample positives are EXCLUDED from the macro mean (variable denominator, undefined-AP rule). AP=0 substitution is NOT used. Report n_eval and n_excluded_undefined per cell.

decomposition.method: descriptive two-way sum-of-squares over the 15 Delta_ij

execution_order: Complete and seal the confirmatory GIN run (15 units x 3 seeds) FIRST; only afterwards add seeds 3 and 4 (the 4th and 5th entries of the ordered list) on the three representative units.
failure_policy: Only pre-defined hard technical failures (crash, OOM, NaN loss) may be retried, exactly once, with the SAME seed and SAME configuration. Seed substitution and outcome-driven retraining are forbidden. All failures and retries are logged.
firewall: Stability results must not change the primary results, hypothesis adjudication, model/hyperparameter/seed selection, or the aggregation method. Stability outputs are written to a directory separate from the confirmatory run outputs.
still_unspecified: inner-validation design within outer-train (split unit/ratio, monitor, patience, min/max epoch, best-checkpoint tie-break)
